title: Tell the comment author who will not be notified: the discussion composer reads withheldMentions
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ① maintainer ruling 6523848208 (#27703, letter A, 「27703 同意」 2026-10-30T13:21Z): "The ui half … follows as its own `domain:ui` card once the key is on `main`." The key landed in PR #28174 (`7811c3f6`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any record discussion where the author @-mentions a colleague who cannot read the record. The server now withholds that notification and tells the author's own request which ids were withheld; the console says nothing, so the author still believes the colleague was told.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`app-shell` record page discussion, `plugin-detail` composer).

## Observed (on `main` at `7811c3f6`)

- `CreateDataResponseSchema` / `UpdateDataResponseSchema` carry `withheldMentions?: string[]` (ids only, no reason, author's own request only, never stored); `@objectstack/client` mirrors it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` writes comments through three callbacks (`dataSource.create('sys_comment', …)` ≈L2980 and ≈L3020, `.update('sys_comment', …)` ≈L3374) and reads nothing from the answer.
- Mention chips are drawn by `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RichTextCommentInput.tsx`.

## Wanted (as ruled)

- The three write callbacks read `withheldMentions`, map the ids to names through the mention picker's suggestions, and say in one sentence who will not be notified (no reason; the ruling's disclosure is one bit per named user). Test plus ablation.
- Mention chips in `RichTextCommentInput.tsx` per the ruling.
- ⛔ Not taken by the ruling: a picker-time readability read (B), so no new endpoint and no probe of colleagues' access.

Dedupe words: withheld mentions notice, mention not notified, comment mention gate toast, withheldMentions console.

Links back: #27703, PR #28174, ruling 6523848208.
